core_principles: No default centered layouts - use asymmetry and tension
Electric Blue accents (#6366f1) for primary actions

Button.default: bg-indigo-500 active:bg-indigo-600 px-6 py-4 rounded-xl flex-row items-center justify-center shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(99,102,241,0.3)]

Card.base: bg-zinc-900/50 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-5 backdrop-blur-md shadow-sm

Input.base: bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-800 text-white px-4 py-4 rounded-xl focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500/50 placeholder-zinc-500

images.description: Modern dark campus architecture for login screen background
Abstract blue light streaks for dashboard header
Coding setup for developer profile background

features.charts: Use react-native-chart-kit for attendance analytics (Pie Chart for %, Line Chart for history)

setup: Install nativewind and tailwindcss for styling: `yarn add nativewind tailwindcss`
Run `npx tailwindcss init` and configure `tailwind.config.js` with the provided colors
implementation_rules: Use `SafeAreaView` from `react-native-safe-area-context` for all screen containers
Do NOT use standard Shadcn web components. Build 'Shadcn-like' components using View/Text + NativeWind classes
Use `ImageBackground` for the Auth screen with the provided `auth_background` image
Developer info must be clickable and open Instagram profile

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use gradients for text (hard to read on mobile)
Use generous padding (p-6, p-8) for touch targets
Ensure 44px min height for all interactive elements
Use Skeleton loaders while fetching data
Always validate data-testid on interactive elements
